actual: The required watchlist_backend lane selected by PR #2834 fails reproducibly on two attempts because the GitHub Actions PostgreSQL service is blank and the job invokes nox directly without bootstrapping app.watchlist_categories, app.watchlist_items, or app.watchlist_item_categories. The lane therefore reports 2 failed and 4 errors before exercising the changed Advisory code. Repair must bootstrap only the disposable CI database through an explicit test-only environment contract, must not run DDL against developer or production databases, and must keep the watchlist tests fail-loud when schema initialization fails.
closure_requirements: Bootstrap the repository-owned Watchlist schema only for the watchlist_backend job's disposable PostgreSQL service.
Keep schema initialization fail-loud and avoid any DDL path for other CI sessions, developer databases, or production databases.
Run workflow smoke, YAML parsing, L0, module ownership, and the GitHub watchlist_backend lane.
Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
